description: Join our friendly and supportive team at Baldwins Lane Surgery as a Medical Receptionist and play a vital role in delivering excellent patient care. As the first point of contact for our patients, you will make a real difference to their experience, helping them access the right care and support. The role is varied and fast-paced, combining front-of-house reception duties with telephone enquiries, appointment booking, managing patient queries and supporting the wider practice team. We are looking for someone who is approachable, compassionate and organised, with excellent communication skills and a positive, can-do attitude. You will need to remain calm under pressure, handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately and be confident using IT systems such as EMIS, Outlook and Microsoft Office. Previous experience in a GP practice or healthcare setting would be beneficial, but just as importantly, we want someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and takes pride in providing a great service. In return, you'll join a welcoming team where your contribution matters, where no two days are the same and where you can develop your skills while making a genuine difference to our local community. If you're a people person who enjoys working in a busy, rewarding environment, we'd love to hear from you! The role involves supporting the day-to-day running of the surgery, including opening and closing the premises, ensuring the practice is ready for patients and maintaining a welcoming and organised environment. You will undertake a range of general administrative duties, including managing emails, supporting QOF activity, updating records and assisting with practice tasks and projects. Flexibility is essential, as you will be expected to support different areas of the practice when needed, respond to changing priorities and work collaboratively with colleagues to ensure the smooth running of the surgery. This is a varied role requiring someone who is organised, proactive and willing to get involved wherever support is needed. The postholder will be a key member of the practice team, helping ensure patients receive a positive experience and that administrative processes are completed accurately and efficiently. Reception and Patient Services Welcome patients and visitors in a friendly and professional manner. Answer telephone calls, manage enquiries and assist patients with appointment bookings. Handle patient queries sensitively, maintaining confidentiality at all times. Signpost patients to appropriate services and colleagues. Maintain a clean, tidy and welcoming reception area.
